label: Imperiled amphibian & reptile species list
caption: Amphibian & reptile Regional Species of Greatest Conservation Need with predicted suitable habitat present based on USGS Southeast Gap Analysis Project species distribution
citation: Southeast Conservation Adaptation Strategy (SECAS). 2026. Southeast Conservation Blueprint 2026.
description: This dataset provides additional details for the imperiled amphibians & reptiles indicator. It provides a list of species with predicted suitable habitat present based on available USGS Southeast Gap Analysis Project species distribution models for Regional Species of Greatest Conservation Need (RSGCN) included in the indicator. Data are limited to limited to non-urban, non-marine areas in the Continental U.S.

label: Intact habitat core size
caption: intact habitat core size range by size class
citation: Southeast Conservation Adaptation Strategy (SECAS). 2026. Southeast Conservation Blueprint 2026.
description: This dataset provides additional details for the intact habitat cores indicator. It shows the size range of large, unfragmented patches of natural habitat. It identifies minimally disturbed natural areas at least 100 acres in size and greater than 200 meters wide. Large areas of intact natural habitat are important for many wildlife species, including reptiles and amphibians, birds, and large mammals. These data originate from Esri's green infrastructure data.

label: Coastal shoreline condition length
caption: Coastal shoreline condition length reported by length instead of area. Note: This is calculated using the original shoreline linework classified in the same way as the coastal shoreline condition indicator, but analyzed using the lines instead of the 30 m pixels used by the indicator. Good condition thresholds reflect the range of indicator values that occur in healthy, functioning ecosystems
citation: Southeast Conservation Adaptation Strategy (SECAS). 2026. Southeast Conservation Blueprint 2026.
description: This dataset supplements the coastal shoreline condition indicator by providing the length of each shoreline condition category present in the area of interest. Coastal shoreline lines are classified into shoreline condition using the same critera as the indicator, but are analyzed using the linework instead of the 30 meter pixels used by the indicator.

label: Imperiled aquatic species count
caption: Total count of unique aquatic animal Regional Species of Greatest Conservation Need observed in the overlapping subwatersheds. Note: You may see minor differences between the indicator results and this total reported count of unique species across all overlapping subwatersheds. This occurs because the indicator uses a slightly older version of the source data, so where they differ, we recommend using the count reported here. Future updates will synchronize both applications
citation: Southeast Conservation Adaptation Strategy (SECAS). 2026. Southeast Conservation Blueprint 2026.
description: This dataset complements the imperiled aquatic species indicator by measuring the total number of unique aquatic animal Regional Species of Greatest Conservation Need (RSGCN) observed across all overlapping 12-digit HUC subwatersheds. This dataset accounts for multiple subwatersheds sharing the same species in order to calculate the count of distinct species.
